reviews.text: Amazing service and lovely people too. Artur and Karla were absolutely fantastic, looking after our two cats, and kept us entertained with messages while we were away. I would highly recommend Dr PetSitter for anyone looking for the piece of mind that their loved ones are in safe hands. Thanks again!

This was the first time we hired a pet-sitting service to take care of our kittens during our vacation, and it was the most peaceful vacation we've ever had. They provided a caring, dedicated, and competent service. I highly recommend them!
Excellent professionals. Perfect for those seeking a carefree vacation, knowing their pet will be treated with great care and responsibility. 5 stars!

Besides being an excellent professional, he demonstrates a care and dedication that makes all the difference!

He was always careful to send photos, videos, and daily updates!

I highly recommend him! I felt super relieved ❤️🐈😻🐈😻

Thank you so much! 😊
We are very happy to know that you enjoyed our service. Taking care of furry friends with love and dedication is a true passion for us. 💛🐾
We are always here for whatever you need!

Excellent service! Professionalism, attention, and great love for my little bunny Birra. I immediately felt calm and very well supported, with constant updates and so much care. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and competent pet sitter. Thank you, Artur. It's clear that you love your job ! 🐰💙 …

Artur is an absolutely exceptional professional. Besides being a veterinarian, which provides immense peace of mind, he has genuine care for animals and an attention to detail that makes all the difference. We have a cat with cerebellar hypoplasia (wobbly), a paraplegic cat, and another cat on multiple medications for inflammatory bowel disease, hyperthyroidism, and behavioral disorders. In total, there are 5. During the pet sitting, Artur kept us informed, was extremely responsible, and treated our cats as if they were his own. I recommend him without hesitation to anyone looking for someone trustworthy, competent, and truly dedicated.

We had an amazing experience with Dr. Artur during our vacation. We were so relieved to know our children were in such good hands! He was always providing feedback, photos, and videos... Knowing we could leave home for a few days and relax with our children is priceless... thank you again 🙏 …

Incredible service! Since Nihal and Tama came into our lives, we've been lucky and pleased to meet Dr. Artur, who, in addition to being an impeccable veterinarian and pet sitter, has also become a dear friend and the "uncle" of our girls.
Our dogs are always radiant whenever they spend some time with him. He is a dedicated professional, passionate about what he does, and this shines through in every gesture and care. You can see that he loves his job and does it with great affection and excellence.
Nihal and Tama wholeheartedly recommend him!
